name: Meesho Ltd
title: Meesho Ltd - 544632 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Meesho is an asset-light marketplace with no capacity to add; the read is margin repair from logistics normalisation (CM exit rate 4%) and ad monetisation, but LTM FCF and CFO remain negative with no guidance given.

triggers.label: Contribution margin exit rate 4%
triggers.quote: the baseline from contribution margin perspective is the 4% Q4 exit rate that we have

triggers.label: Annual transacting users +33% Y-o-Y
triggers.quote: we are able to grow our annual transacting user base at 33% Y-o-Y

triggers.label: Ad budgets more than doubled in a year
triggers.quote: the budget over the last one year for us has grown more than double actually

triggers.label: CFO negative, scale widening
triggers.quote: The scale of that negative number has expanded quarter on quarter for the past three quarters now

triggers.label: No EBITDA or FCF guidance given
triggers.quote: we don't have any specific guidances to share at this point on EBITDA

guidance.quote: we don't have any specific guidances to share at this point on EBITDA

red_flags.label: Negative CFO widening for three quarters
red_flags.quote: The scale of that negative number has expanded quarter on quarter for the past three quarters now

red_flags.label: Revenue optics distorted by accounting change
red_flags.quote: There has been a change in terms of how reported revenues are kind of being accounted for

evasions.quote: the trends that you're looking at may include certain one -offs that have been kind of there from past periods
there's no quantitative sense that we'd be able to provide
